title: Nested-annulus Riesz bootstrap gives C1 off the origin at all positive orders

statement.quantifiers: Positive continuous integral solution, any compact annuli away0,0<s<n.
statement.assertion: u,v and weighted sources are C1 locally away0; for s<=1 finite Hölder iteration resolves singular gradient concerns.
assumptions: Localized source bounded/compact and potential globally bounded; nonlinear powers smooth on positive compact value intervals.

inputs: Exactly scoped integral/weak-PDE objects and source hypotheses.
outputs: Analytic lemma, proof mechanism or scope obstruction, not an external/formal certificate.
interface.precision: Exact order, dimension, origin/tail/local-versus-global conditions retained.
costs: Finite iteration depends s; no uniform algorithm/explicit constant charge supplied.

proof_mechanism: Complementary potential derivatives dominated by a fixed finite potential.
Bounded RHS yields any Hölder rho<s.
Nested cutoffs and gains at least s/2 until rho+s>1; s>1 uses integrable kernel gradient.
obstructions: No direct absolutely convergent full potential gradient claimed at s<=1.
Primary author PDF is cited, not packaged.
